notes:
What's new in 0.1.121:
- Library and Organizer: two library folders that hold a file with the same name no longer give two films the same id (the first folder wins), the library search ignores accents, apostrophes, punctuation and extra spaces, the Organizer keeps both episodes of a double-episode file in its name, and its scan skips trailers, samples and extras-folder videos. A folder that holds both Shelf and shelf is kept apart.
- Watching in the browser: the resume question uses your newest spot instead of an older one from the server, a short network drop can now reload the film quietly each time it happens, and the error box shows the format words again after a Reconnecting message. The photo viewer zooms around the pointer with the wheel, plus and minus, drag to pan, double-click to toggle, and Esc or 0 to reset.
- Live TV: Cancel, Delete and Remove on Recordings now show the server's reason when it refuses, instead of silently reloading.
- Settings and screens: Appearance Fix automatically and Import Apply no longer wipe edits you have not saved, the nightly backup boxes keep focus after each digit, the Stop sharing button keeps its normal height, the Shared with you share-code card lines up with the others, and Audiobooks no longer says Nothing matches under a load error.
- Smaller fixes: a bad percent-escape in a collection, show or actor address now gives not found instead of a server error, and the Photos map caps its pin list so a huge library stays responsive.
- Automated tests and code review only; this build has not been installed on a PC or tried on a TV, phone or Jellyfin app by a person yet. 0.1.120 was published on November 14, 2026.
